title: Model Checkpoints for SAR-Flood-Surrogate
description: Pre-trained model weights for SAR-constrained flood inundation surrogate modelling. Study event: July 2023 Daqinghe River flood, North China Plain. This archive includes three pre-trained U-Net models (Vanilla 6ch, ResNet34 6ch, Vanilla 7ch). Code available at https://github.com/kaedez-hydro/SAR-Flood-Surrogate
